name: Aizumisato (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Aizumisato town emblem in green and blue: a green stylised mountain and leaf above a blue wave.
history: Municipal flag of Aizumisato, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 16 December 2005.

features.role: Aizumisato town emblem — a green stylised mountain and leaf above a blue wave
